arxiv: Download progress shown ('a download in progress'); failures honest ('arXiv sent something unreadable').
backgammon: Autosave writes via store().save but on_store only handles Loaded; a Denied autosave is invisible - the player quits believing 'Resumed saved game' will work.
birds: No in-app save flow; content arrives prepared from the computer.
calibre-web: Honest saving states throughout: 'Library changes are not saved. Free some space, then retry saving.', 'Wait for the library to finish loading or saving.'
crossword: Draft Status::Failed drives a full 'Progress is not saved' screen with Retry save; latest letters kept.
fanshelf: DownloadState enum and waiting counts ('{updates} waiting') show work before success; EPUB save failure keeps previous copy and says so.
flashcards: sample_saving flag shows a saving state; review-log failures honest ('Review not saved. The imported schedule was left unchanged.').
frame: No in-app save flow; photos arrive prepared from the computer.
grimoire: No storage writes; bookmarks are session state and make no persistence claim.
habits: Handles StoreResult::Denied: 'A local change could not be saved: {error}. It will be lost if Habits closes.'; save_in_flight coalescing.
homepanel: 'Not connected' states and 'Updated. Checking status…' keep pending visible.
inkling: StoreResult::Denied handled explicitly: 'Progress could not be saved. Check available storage.'
kitchencard: '{} recipe{} from Mealie {} waiting.' shows the queue; 'Recipes could not be saved or opened. Retry saving before closing.'
musicstand: No in-app save flow; scores arrive prepared from the computer.
needles: 'Opening your synced pattern…' precedes the opened pattern; unreadable transfers say so and name the fix.
nonograms: Shared Draft: Status::Saving|Unsaved rendered, 'Not saved · More to retry'.
panels: Status::Saving|Unsaved shown in chrome; saves coalesced; every failure string names the retry ('Free some space, then retry.').
paperterm: Pairing saves are scrupulously honest: 'Pairing was not saved. Your previous pairing is unchanged.', 'Waiting for this computer to confirm pairing. Your saved connection has not been changed.'
parlor: Same shape as backgammon: store().save autosave, on_store ignores Denied; 'Resume saved game' keeps promising a game that may not exist.
parser: Shelf-write failure surfaced: 'The save could not be written. Check free space.'; damaged restores refused honestly.
pubquiz: 'Not synced yet.' is the only state claim and it is honest.
sudoku: Shared Draft (Saved/Unsaved/Saving/Failed) drives status; tests cover the denial path.
syncthing: The whole app is an honest status surface: 'Bytes left', 'Next window', 'Not run yet', 'Some files could not sync. They retry on the next window.'
vault: Loading enum gates success; import counts shown after completion.
verses: 'This reader would not keep that favourite. Try marking it again.'
audiobook: Full staged progress screen ('Creating audiobook', per-stage labels with percents, 'Saving to My Books', 'Saving audiobook' at 94%).
brief: 'This story is open but not saved for offline reading.'; fallback copy honest.
gallery: Specimen app; specimen saves are inert demonstrations, not claims.
gutenbird: Only pending strings; success is the opened book itself.
hn: Sync-local saved marker; no async gap.
